next.reason: 1985: the PROGRAM-ID program-name 'must conform to the rules for formation of a user-defined word.' 2023 §2023:11.10.2 writes the operand as program-name-1; §2023:5.2.4 makes such an operand an instance of 'Any of the types listed in 8.3.2.2', and §2023:8.3.2.2 lists program-name among the user-defined words (the externalized name goes in the separate AS literal-1). The requirement is unchanged; the catalog has no rule id for the 8.3.2.2 list, so the format is the record's only id. Changes to word formation itself belong to that rule's own record.
